name: 32976 · Micco, FL
findings: ZIP 32976 (Micco) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32976 (Micco) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
